newsitem.title: SWEDEN: S&P rates MoDo Swedish program K-1.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates MoDo Swedish program K-1.

text.p: U.S. rating agency Standard & Poor's said on Wednesday it assigned Swedish forestry group MoDo AB a K-1 rating for its Swedish commercial paper program.
"The rating reflects MoDo's better-than-average business profile as reflected in its cost position, level of product diversity, integration and sound financial profile," S&P said in a statement.
MoDo, one of Europe's largest paper and paperboard producers with an annual capacity of 2.8 million tonnes, has machines that are large and well maintained.
They "should provide the group with a competitive cost structure," the agency said.
But because production has a Swedish bias, income is sensitive to general cost levels in Sweden, which to a large extent are out of MoDo's control, S&P said.
Reflecting the nature of the industry, income and cash flow is cyclical, the agency said.
"To balance the cyclicality, a sound financial profile is key, and MoDo is well placed in this respect," the agency said.
